_provenance.what: The references of BENCHMARK_PLAN.md sec. 4 row 9 (the equal-spin-temperature identity) and the numbers the harness checks against them. The identity itself is analytic; the COMPASS numbers are published values transcribed with attribution.
_provenance.formula: spin 1 at one spin temperature, p_m ~ exp(beta m): P_z = 2 sinh(beta)/(2 cosh(beta) + 1), P_zz = 1 - 3 p0 = (2 cosh(beta) - 2)/(2 cosh(beta) + 1), hence P_zz = 2 - sqrt(4 - 3 P_z^2). Any J: <m>/J = B_J(J beta), B_J the Brillouin function.
_provenance.convention: Cartesian P_zz = <3 Jz^2 - 2> = 1 - 3 p0 per ion (J = 1), LiPolGen's. KOIVUNIEMI'S T IS HALF OF IT: their Fig. 1 caption defines T = 1/2 (1 - 3 p0). Rule 3 of BENCHMARK_PLAN.md sec. 8: all quantities are per nucleus (per ion); rules 1 and 2 do not apply (no b1, no structure function).

statements_verbatim: The deuteron and 6Li in the target material have nuclear spin quantum number 1.
In the absence of quadrupole splitting, only one narrow nuclear magnetic resonance line, 3 kHz wide, is seen
The intensity of the absorption signal integrated over the frequency is proportional to the population difference
where the spin number J = 1 for deuteron and 6Li, and J = 3/2 for 7Li. Here x = h f0 / kB TS
at the nominal NMR field of 2.506 T, corresponding to the resonance frequency f0 of 16.379 MHz

We have carefully checked that during the polarization all the nuclei share the same spin temperature [1]. Thus the calculation of the polarizations of 6Li and 7Li can be done from Eq. 2, using the measured deuteron polarization and the resonance frequencies for 6Li and 7Li in the 2.506 T field.

The tensor polarization can be estimated to be T = 1/2(1 - 3p0) = 11 % at the maximum. The highest polarizations correspond to a spin temperature TS of 0.87 mK or -0.87 mK for negative polarization. From Eq. 2 the polarization of 6Li can be estimated to be +-51.3 % and the polarization of 7Li +-92.4 %.
koivuniemi2004.fig1_note: the figure labels levels by energy (E-, E0, E+) and P = p- - p+; the deuteron's lowest level E- is the spin ALONG the field, so 'aligned' above is E- for the downstream cell. Printed to 0.1 %.
koivuniemi2004.refs_dict_correction: PolarizedLithiumSim/refs/refs_dict.json entry koivuniemi2004-compass-polarization-buildup quotes '51 +- 3 %' and '92 +- 4 %': the rendered caption reads '+-51.3 %' and '+-92.4 %' (the +- is the sign of the polarization, the 3 and 4 are decimals).
